back: Categories → bar; parts of a whole → pie or divided bar; change over time → line; two variables → scatter; three parts of 100% → triangular.
Bar chart of continuous classes; bars touch because there are no gaps between classes.
A relationship between two variables: positive (both rise), negative (one rises, other falls) or none.
A straight line through the middle of scatter points, with roughly equal numbers either side.
Rose chart: wind frequency by direction. Kite graph: species cover along a transect.
Shows inputs, processes and outputs, e.g. a farm system.
